data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘khayr,’ meaning good, beautiful, or excellent. In Islamic culture, the name Khairy symbolizes righteousness, wisdom, and inner beauty. The name Khairy carries the meaning “Elegant, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khairy usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.
